svg.title: tree repair
svg.desc:
Left panel: a black last_key node has a red middle_key left child and subtree D on its right; middle has a red first_key left child and C on its right; first has A and B. Right panel: a red middle_key node has black first_key and last_key children, with A and B below first and C and D below last. Each node retains its key and value; A through D retain the four surrounding subtrees.
